messages:
marta: Quick thread — planning a one-off 'newsletter surge' for next Thu to push the Benchmark blog + webinar signups. Need segmentation, subject-line + send windows. Who can own which piece? :rocket:
kevin: I can own segmenting and suppression rules. propose splits: trial-users (20k), active-devs (8k), enterprise-prospects (3k). keep enterprise separate cadence.
sam: I can do subject lines + preview text. rough options: `Benchmark: 2x perf, 30% cheaper` / `See how teams cut LLM cost by 30%` / `Join our webinar: inference benchmarks that matter` — prefer A/B test between 1 and 3.
nina: I'll schedule on SendGrid and handle throttles. prefer Wed 9am PST for trial-users and Thu 11am PST for active-devs to avoid overlap. confirm suppression: no send to anyone who got an email in last 7 days or unsubscribed tags `benchmark` or `webinar`.
derek: I'll wire in the webinar CTAs in the newsletter copy and add UTM tracking. UTM plan: `utm_campaign=newsletter_surge_mar2026`, `utm_source=newsletter`, `utm_medium=email`, and `utm_content` keyed by segment. Also will include 2 CTAs: primary register, secondary read benchmark.
marta: Nice. kevin — how confident are counts? do we need to pare down to hit bounces and quota?
kevin: counts are raw. after suppressions and bounces expect ~85% deliverability. will run suppression query today and post final counts by EOD.
sam: For A/B: subject A (benchmark stat) vs B (webinar invite). small send: 5% of each segment at 9am PT on Wed, learn which wins, then roll to rest. sound good? :eyes: 
nina: sounds good. small send will be a separate campaign tagged `surge_ab_test`. I need final subject copy by 10am Tue to queue.
derek: also syncing with comms: teaser post on X + org chart in workspace. will we include a thank-you promo code for attendees?
marta: Not for this go — keep focus on trial-to-webinar + benchmark reads. But we can add an enterprise follow-up nurture with offer.
kevin: FYI — exclude any leads with open-rate <1% in last 3 months for the active-devs segment. reduces noise.
sam: Draft subjects (short):
```
A1: Benchmark: Inference cost down 30% — see how
B1: Webinar: Live deep-dive on inference benchmarks (register)
```
Pick A1 for trial-users test, B1 for active-devs test?
marta: Yes. assign: kevin = segments & final counts; sam = subject + creative; nina = scheduling; derek = copy + UTMs. I will coordinate send approvals and reporting.
deploy-bot: campaign queued: newsletter_surge_AB_test (small send) — scheduled for 2026-03-25T16:00:00Z if approvals complete.
kevin: I'll post the suppression query and final counts in this thread when done.
marta: Thanks team — final checklist: 1) subjects + preview (sam) 2) suppression & counts (kevin) 3) layout + CTAs (derek) 4) schedule + throttles (nina) 5) approvals (marta). Please ping if blocked. :calendar:
